$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'
if ([IntPtr]::Size -ne 8) { 'SYNTHETIC_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED'; exit 1 }
$assembly=[AppDomain]::CurrentDomain.DefineDynamicAssembly((New-Object Reflection.AssemblyName('SyntheticSignerMemory')), [Reflection.Emit.AssemblyBuilderAccess]::Run)
$module=$assembly.DefineDynamicModule('ManagedOnly')
$type=$module.DefineType('SyntheticNativeMethods',[Reflection.TypeAttributes]'Public,Abstract,Sealed')
$fields=@{}
foreach($name in @('ProviderPointer','SignerPointer','LeafPointer')) {
  $fields[$name]=$type.DefineField($name,[IntPtr],[Reflection.FieldAttributes]'Public,Static')
}
foreach($name in @('PolicyChecked','PolicyError','PolicyWrites','CloseStatus','ManagedDisposals','DisposedAtClose','CloseCalls')) {
  $fields[$name]=$type.DefineField($name,[int],[Reflection.FieldAttributes]'Public,Static')
}
foreach($definition in @(
  [pscustomobject]@{Name='WTHelperProvDataFromStateData';Pointer='ProviderPointer';Parameters=[Type[]]@([IntPtr])},
  [pscustomobject]@{Name='WTHelperGetProvSignerFromChain';Pointer='SignerPointer';Parameters=[Type[]]@([IntPtr],[uint32],[int],[uint32])},
  [pscustomobject]@{Name='WTHelperGetProvCertFromChain';Pointer='LeafPointer';Parameters=[Type[]]@([IntPtr],[uint32])}
)) {
  $method=$type.DefineMethod($definition.Name,[Reflection.MethodAttributes]'Public,Static',[IntPtr],$definition.Parameters)
  $il=$method.GetILGenerator()
  $il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Ldsfld,$fields[$definition.Pointer])
  $il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Ret)
}
$method=$type.DefineMethod('CertVerifyCertificateChainPolicy',[Reflection.MethodAttributes]'Public,Static',[int],[Type[]]@([IntPtr],[IntPtr],[IntPtr],[IntPtr]))
$il=$method.GetILGenerator()
$skip=$il.DefineLabel()
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Ldsfld,$fields.PolicyWrites)
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Brfalse,$skip)
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Ldarg_3)
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Ldc_I4_4)
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Ldsfld,$fields.PolicyError)
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Call,[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal].GetMethod('WriteInt32',[Type[]]@([IntPtr],[int],[int])))
$il.MarkLabel($skip)
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Ldsfld,$fields.PolicyChecked)
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Ret)
$method=$type.DefineMethod('WinVerifyTrust',[Reflection.MethodAttributes]'Public,Static',[int],[Type[]]@([IntPtr],[IntPtr],[IntPtr]))
$il=$method.GetILGenerator()
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Ldsfld,$fields.ManagedDisposals)
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Stsfld,$fields.DisposedAtClose)
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Ldsfld,$fields.CloseCalls)
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Ldc_I4_1)
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Add)
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Stsfld,$fields.CloseCalls)
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Ldsfld,$fields.CloseStatus)
$il.Emit([Reflection.Emit.OpCodes]::Ret)
$nativeType=$type.CreateType()
$script:mockNativeType=$nativeType
$native=$nativeType.GetMethod('WinVerifyTrust')
function Set-Mock([string]$name,$value) { $nativeType.GetField($name).SetValue($null,$value) }
function Get-Mock([string]$name) { $nativeType.GetField($name).GetValue($null) }
function New-Memory([int]$size) {
  $pointer=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::AllocHGlobal($size)
  [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::Copy((New-Object byte[] $size),0,$pointer,$size)
  return $pointer
}
$cases=@(
  @('valid','NONE',1),@('index-unwritten','signature-index-unknown',0),@('index-other','signature-index-unknown',0),
  @('state-null','provider-unknown',0),@('provider-null','provider-unknown',0),
  @('signer-null','signer-unknown',0),@('signer-size','signer-unknown',0),@('signer-error','signer-unknown',0),
  @('chain-zero','chain-unknown',0),@('chain-over','chain-unknown',0),@('chain-null','chain-unknown',0),
  @('leaf-null','leaf-unknown',0),@('leaf-size','leaf-unknown',0),@('leaf-error','leaf-unknown',0),@('context-null','leaf-unknown',0),
  @('policy-false','root-policy-rejected',1),@('policy-error','root-policy-rejected',1),@('policy-unwritten','root-policy-rejected',1),
  @('subject-over','subject-unsupported',1),@('eku-over','eku-unsupported',1),@('eku-count','eku-unsupported',1),
  @('close-failure','NONE',1)
)
$summaries=@()
foreach($case in $cases) {
  foreach($name in @('PolicyError','CloseStatus','ManagedDisposals','DisposedAtClose','CloseCalls')) { Set-Mock $name ([int]0) }
  Set-Mock 'PolicyChecked' ([int]1); Set-Mock 'PolicyWrites' ([int]1)
  $signatureSettings=New-Memory 32; $data=New-Memory 88; $fileInfo=New-Memory 32; $action=New-Memory 16
  $pathBuffer=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::StringToHGlobalUni('synthetic-only')
  $signerMemory=New-Memory 64; $leafMemory=New-Memory 88
  $policyPara=[IntPtr]::Zero; $policyStatus=[IntPtr]::Zero
  [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt32($signatureSettings,16,0)
  [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteIntPtr($data,56,[IntPtr]1)
  [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt32($signerMemory,0,64)
  [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt32($signerMemory,12,3)
  [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteIntPtr($signerMemory,56,[IntPtr]1)
  [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt32($leafMemory,0,88)
  [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteIntPtr($leafMemory,8,[IntPtr]1)
  Set-Mock 'ProviderPointer' ([IntPtr]1); Set-Mock 'SignerPointer' $signerMemory; Set-Mock 'LeafPointer' $leafMemory
  $syntheticCertificate=[pscustomobject]@{SubjectName=[pscustomobject]@{RawData=[byte[]]@(0x30,0)};Extensions=@([pscustomobject]@{Oid=[pscustomobject]@{Value='2.5.29.37'};RawData=[byte[]]@(0x30,0)})}
  $syntheticCertificate | Add-Member -MemberType ScriptMethod -Name Dispose -Value { $script:mockNativeType.GetField('ManagedDisposals').SetValue($null,[int]1) }
  $script:fileDisposals=0
  $file=[pscustomobject]@{}
  $file | Add-Member -MemberType ScriptMethod -Name Dispose -Value { $script:fileDisposals++ }
  switch($case[0]) {
    'index-unwritten' { [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt32($signatureSettings,16,-1) }
    'index-other' { [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt32($signatureSettings,16,1) }
    'state-null' { [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteIntPtr($data,56,[IntPtr]::Zero) }
    'provider-null' { Set-Mock 'ProviderPointer' ([IntPtr]::Zero) }
    'signer-null' { Set-Mock 'SignerPointer' ([IntPtr]::Zero) }
    'signer-size' { [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt32($signerMemory,0,63) }
    'signer-error' { [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt32($signerMemory,40,5) }
    'chain-zero' { [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt32($signerMemory,12,0) }
    'chain-over' { [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt32($signerMemory,12,17) }
    'chain-null' { [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteIntPtr($signerMemory,56,[IntPtr]::Zero) }
    'leaf-null' { Set-Mock 'LeafPointer' ([IntPtr]::Zero) }
    'leaf-size' { [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt32($leafMemory,0,87) }
    'leaf-error' { [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt32($leafMemory,40,5) }
    'context-null' { [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteIntPtr($leafMemory,8,[IntPtr]::Zero) }
    'policy-false' { Set-Mock 'PolicyChecked' ([int]0) }
    'policy-error' { Set-Mock 'PolicyError' ([int]5) }
    'policy-unwritten' { Set-Mock 'PolicyWrites' ([int]0) }
    'subject-over' { $syntheticCertificate.SubjectName.RawData=New-Object byte[] 4097 }
    'eku-over' { $syntheticCertificate.Extensions[0].RawData=New-Object byte[] 129 }
    'eku-count' { $syntheticCertificate.Extensions=@($syntheticCertificate.Extensions[0]) * 5 }
    'close-failure' { Set-Mock 'CloseStatus' ([int]1) }
  }
  $result=[ordered]@{category='offline-signature-observed';verifiedSignatureIndex=$null;verifiedSignerObserved=$false;microsoftRootPolicyChecked=$false;microsoftRootPolicyStatus=$null;subjectDer=$null;ekuDer=@();stateClosed=$false}
  $observedError='NONE'; $unexpected=$false; $stateMayReferenceBuffers=$true; $script:freeCount=0
  try {
__ACTUAL_GUARD__
  } catch { $unexpected=$true }
  finally {
__ACTUAL_CLEANUP__
  }
  $closeFailed=$case[0] -ceq 'close-failure'
  $expectedFree=if($case[2] -eq 1){7}else{5}
  $pass=(-not $unexpected -and $observedError -ceq $case[1] -and (Get-Mock 'ManagedDisposals') -eq $case[2] -and (Get-Mock 'DisposedAtClose') -eq $case[2] -and (Get-Mock 'CloseCalls') -eq 1)
  if($closeFailed) { $pass=$pass -and $stateMayReferenceBuffers -and -not $result.stateClosed -and $script:freeCount -eq 0 -and $script:fileDisposals -eq 0 -and $result.category -ceq 'cleanup-uncertain' }
  else {
    $pass=$pass -and -not $stateMayReferenceBuffers -and $result.stateClosed -and $script:freeCount -eq $expectedFree -and $script:fileDisposals -eq 1
    [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::FreeHGlobal($signerMemory); [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::FreeHGlobal($leafMemory)
  }
  $summaries += [ordered]@{case=$case[0];passed=[bool]$pass;classification=$observedError;managedDisposed=[int](Get-Mock 'ManagedDisposals');disposedAtClose=[int](Get-Mock 'DisposedAtClose');closeCalls=[int](Get-Mock 'CloseCalls');ownedFreed=$script:freeCount;fileDisposed=$script:fileDisposals;retainedUntilProcessExit=[bool]$stateMayReferenceBuffers}
  if(-not $pass) { break }
}
$passed=@($summaries|Where-Object{-not $_.passed}).Count -eq 0 -and $summaries.Count -eq $cases.Count
[ordered]@{scope='SYNTHETIC_MEMORY_ONLY';caseCount=$summaries.Count;passed=[bool]$passed;summaries=$summaries;compilerExecuted=$false;signatureVerified=$false;compilerTrust='pending'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 5
if(-not $passed) { exit 1 }
